testCase.description: DMN 1.6 §11.9 example table: "Today is " + today() -> FEEL null, B-FEEL "Today is 2020-01-01" (the spec assumes today is 2020-01-01; this test fixes the date). DMN 1.6 §11.9 rules added after Table 58 "in order of precedence": string ("converted to a string using the string B-FEEL function ... Subtraction returns an empty string"), number ("converted to a number using the number B-FEEL function"), date and time, date, time, years and months duration, days and time duration ("converted to a duration using the duration B-FEEL function").

DMN 1.6 §11.9 example table: "Today is " + today() (spec expression with the real today()): the date is converted with the string B-FEEL function. FEEL: left side null, so false. DMN 1.6 §11.11 (derived): "a" converts to 0, 2 ** 0 = 1; FEEL null. DMN 1.6 §11.11 "The FEEL semantics of exponentiation described in Table 61 (grammar rule 23) are used and B-FEEL further specifies that each operand is converted to a number using the number B-FEEL function."

DMN 1.6 §11.11 (derived): null converts to 0 (as in the spec's 1 + null = 1), 0 ** 2 = 0; FEEL null. DMN 1.6 §11.11 "The FEEL semantics of exponentiation described in Table 61 (grammar rule 23) are used and B-FEEL further specifies that each operand is converted to a number using the number B-FEEL function."

DMN 1.6 §11.11 (derived): number("3") = 3, 3 ** 2 = 9; FEEL null. DMN 1.6 §11.11 "The FEEL semantics of exponentiation described in Table 61 (grammar rule 23) are used and B-FEEL further specifies that each operand is converted to a number using the number B-FEEL function."

DMN 1.6 §11.9 (derived): date and time rule; null is converted with the duration B-FEEL function to a zero duration (P0M or PT0S), and date and time + zero duration is the same value under either Table 58 row; FEEL null. DMN 1.6 §11.9 "The non-date and time value is converted to a duration using the duration B-FEEL function and Table 58 applies."
